phone.description: Indian mobile number, any common format

bio.example: Weekend trekker, happy to lend my camera.

key.description: Pass this key to the endpoint that uses the file

headers.description: Headers to send with the PUT (they are part of the signature)

commissionBps.description: Platform commission on rent, basis points

distanceKm.description: Rounded to 0.5 km; under 1 km is reported as 0.5 ("< 1 km")

available.description: Still live (wishlists keep items that were taken down)

ratingAvg.description: Average of borrowers’ published reviews of rentals of this item

days.description: Inclusive: pickup day to return day

description.example: Waterproof, used on 3 treks. Comes with pegs and a carry bag.

reason.example: Photos show a different item than the title.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived (5 min) token for the 2FA step. Not an access token.

qrDataUrl.description: PNG data URL of the QR code to scan

ids.description: Every category id, in the new order

isActive.description: Hidden from the apps when false; existing listings stay

hasBack.description: Whether a back side was uploaded

activity.description: Latest 50 audit entries by or about this user

reason.example: Repeated no-shows reported by three lenders

website.description: Honeypot. Hidden from people; bots fill it in. Must be empty.

alreadyJoined.description: True if this email was already on the list

upTo.description: Everything up to and including this one; omit to mark all read

pushBookings.description: Push: requests, payments, handover, return, disputes, refunds

emailBookings.description: Email: receipts, refunds and dispute outcomes

conversationId.description: The chat it came from, for context

label.description: A short description: a name, a listing title or the message text

originalText.description: For messages: what the sender typed (admins only)

note.description: What was done, for the record

masked.description: Contact details were hidden from the other person

status.description: Listing status; chats continue if it is paused

rentPaise.description: pricePerDay × days (no weekly discount on a negotiated price)

blockedByMe.description: The viewer blocked the other person

canMessage.description: Messages and offers are allowed (no block either way)

upTo.description: Everything up to and including this message

refundedPaise.description: Refunded so far (processed or on the way)

viewable.description: The lender can open it now

views.description: Who opened it and when (shown to the borrower only; empty for the lender)

reviewDocs.description: Lender: approve or reject shared documents now

return.description: Borrower: confirm the return with the lender’s code

dispute.description: Lender: report a problem (claim from the deposit)

respond.description: Borrower: reply to the lender’s claim

claimUntil.description: The lender can report a problem until then

publishedAt.description: Null while hidden (until both have reviewed, or 7 days)

expiresAt.description: The current step times out then (the booking expires)

payment.description: The payment, once one was made (or the latest attempt)

pickupAddress.description: Exact pickup address: the borrower sees it once the booking is confirmed

rental.description: Handover, return and late fee (paid bookings)

shares.description: One vault document per required document

lenderCancellations.description: Bookings this lender cancelled after accepting
